series.title: Poetry of the Spirit
series.description: Three much-loved books of devotional and reflective verse, from medieval Persia to twentieth-century Bengal and Lebanon. Best read slowly, a few pages at a time.

books.title: The Prophet
books.author: Kahlil Gibran
books.shortDescription: Before sailing home, the prophet Almustafa answers the townspeople’s questions about love, work, children, freedom, death and more. Twenty-six short prose poems framed by his arrival and farewell.
